title: Phase composition and solid solution strengthening effect in TiZrNbMoV high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc-melting pure metals (>99 wt.%) in a water-cooled copper hearth under Ti-gettered argon, flipped/remelted five times, then drop-cast into a 3mm diameter copper mold
